question: Can body shift/recenter use a shorter smooth time parameterization at the original .015 m commanded ZMP acceleration budget and all original physical gates, producing a stronger fixed baseline for later RL?
old_evidence: C31 fixed cycles 9.69/9.71 s; body shift+recenter ~5.47 s; XY/lambda RL did not qualify. Old baselines reuse only after full reset/200-control entry bridge equality.

authority.controller: C31 fixed XY 8 mm-or-span retraction and lambda=.5; no learned residuals
authority.only_new_authority: body shift and recenter time parameterization, common fixed alpha per development case
authority.higher_jerk_disclosure: Finite jerk may exceed old quintic peak jerk. No claim of unchanged jerk/velocity demand. Keep actuator clips and torque-cost gates and measure actual motion.

all transition and abort gates, 77 frozen control invariants, B22 weights/training prohibition

curve.implementation: Same mathematical curve and same actual span/T supply all three references before torque computation. Preserve original previous-interval dynamic margin semantics. Recenter uses identical path.

cases.cancel_cases: Selected fixed alpha, each direction, cancel next control after first genuine two-velocity overlap; original <=300-control safe handoff +400 retention +100 tail.
cases.selection: Eligible alpha must pass both directions full old gates and torque/error/retention comparisons. Select minimum max(left cycle s,right cycle s); tie choose lower mean full torque-square cost, then larger duration. Same alpha in both directions. Publish every attempted candidate.
cases.stop: Any hard safety/native/source/entry failure stops campaign. A controlled safe task failure closes this and all higher-alpha development points; only earlier eligible fixed winner cancellation may continue. No automatic replacement or retry.

gates.nominal_fixed_engineering_gain: Both directions cycle<=.95*old C30 fixed AND <=.90*old zero; no averaging. This is fixed engineering gain, never RL gain.
gates.full_tau2_cost: <=1.10*old fixed AND <=1.20*old zero; tau squared is not energy
gates.safety: All old audited non-speed gates unchanged including whole-wheel native clearance, load/contact/no unwanted airborne slip, stopped/load handoff, retention, torque/native source/count invariants and entry pairing. Do not loosen thresholds to pass S-curve.

source_requirements: New continuation33 paths only; retain old sources/data.
